sloka: ततो बाणमयं वर्षं व्यसृजद्राक्षसोरसि ।शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसम्पन्नो विव्यथे न स राक्षसः ।। ७.६९.११ ॥
transliteration: tato bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ vyasṛjadrākṣasorasi ।śatrughno vīryasampanno vivyathe na sa rākṣasaḥ ।। 7.69.11 ॥

translations.english: Then, the valorous Shatrughna unleashed a shower of arrows upon the demon's chest, but that demon was not pained by them.
